protocol.name: hyperdbdiag_dbmags_retrieve_contract_arbitrate_v11_epdg
protocol.llm_authority: may only choose between a hypergraph fallback and one candidate challenger; the direct ablation uses the training-OOF-sized top pair without local-judge decisions, while the complete method uses the locally retained structured-evidence pair; both require relation-specific stable positive grouped-OOF calibration and fail closed otherwise

hypergraph_training_selection.selection_policy: registered shared core defaults; no outer evaluation result used

epdg.root_metric_paths: registered mechanism paths plus stable signed root-metric paths learned from the current outer training fold
epdg.hypergraph_use: registered root-metric paths weight training hyperedge incidence; held-out query incidence uses no labels
epdg.cross_layer_paths: only frozen direct root-to-anonymous SQL/plan-shape atoms; raw SQL, identifiers, plans, and evaluation labels are excluded
epdg.fusion_selection: joint grouped inner-OOF selection with at least 0.01 absolute Exact gain required for nonzero EPDG fusion
epdg.unavailable_output: no SQL-template or execution-operator binding is emitted

protocol.ordinary_graph_training_selection: fixed shared baseline defaults inside each outer training split

evidence_eligibility.epdg_predictor_support: registered root-metric paths and direct anonymous runtime SQL-shape atoms
evidence_eligibility.llm_support: KPI-time trajectory, training-fold root profiles, anonymous SQL-shape atoms, and frozen mechanism cards
evidence_eligibility.excluded: raw SQL text, plans, source case IDs, scenarios, injection records, and evaluation labels
evidence_eligibility.reason: EPDG may use only registered direct anonymous SQL-shape paths; local and LLM review use the same bounded atoms plus training-grounded evidence.

protocol.local_structured_support: training-OOF-sized H candidate pool, group-balanced training profiles, frozen mechanism cards, and current anonymous semantic evidence when available; no evaluation labels, raw SQL, plans, source IDs, scenarios, or provenance
protocol.llm_structural_support: query KPI-time trajectory, anonymous SQL-shape atoms when available, outer-training root profiles, candidate-set topology, ECSA relation taxonomy, and frozen mechanism cards; local-judge runs may include two structured evidence cards, while the direct hypergraph-LLM run receives neutral candidate cards; no raw SQL, plans, source IDs, scenarios, case IDs, posterior values, candidate ranks, distances, or rarity
protocol.ordinary_graph_hypergraph_boundary: same KPI rows and labels only; no shared candidate inventory, decoder, fitted parameters, or output threshold
protocol.truth_access: evaluation labels are not passed to fit, evidence construction, prediction, or LLM calibration

stage.structure: fixed pairwise KPI graph with independent root-wise classifiers
signed-incidence higher-order hypergraph without EPDG path-prior fusion
stage.ablation_target: EPDG root-aware training incidence and direct anonymous SQL/plan path prior

stage.structure: signed-incidence higher-order hypergraph with EPDG path-prior fusion and joint root-set decoding
training-OOF-sized hypergraph pool plus local structured-evidence contraction
hypergraph top candidate-pair handoff with anonymous evidence and relation-aware LLM arbitration; no local structured-judge decision

steps: Review the current lock-wait relationships and row-lock wait context exposed by the instrumentation.
Correlate blocker/waiter relationships with active session context only to validate whether a bounded lock chain exists.
Treat the correlated lock-wait metrics as one evidence family, consistent with the observation guidance.
preconditions: Diagnosis/root set remains frozen as record_lock.
Use read-only inspection of existing lock-wait instrumentation only.
Do not terminate sessions, change transactions, alter schema, or change configuration.
verification: Confirm whether current data-lock wait relationships or row_lock_wait evidence are still present.
Document whether a specific wait chain pattern is visible for later human remediation planning.
If no current wait relationship is visible, record that the lock condition may have cleared and avoid recommending state-changing action.
rollback: No database rollback is required for a read-only review.
Discard any local notes or working copies if the review is abandoned.

steps: Review the current anonymous runtime SQL-shape artifacts behind observation-02 and observation-03.
Check only for whether the direct semantic query-shape role described in mechanism-01, multi_table_join, is present or absent in those artifacts.
Do not treat broad_filtered_scan, filtered_relation_read, or range_or_comparison_predicate alone as proof of query_with_too_much_join.
preconditions: Use only existing non-mutating execution_plan and instrumented_statement_history artifacts referenced by the current observations.
Do not execute, rewrite, terminate, restart, or change any SQL, schema, indexes, configuration, or sessions.
Keep the frozen root set unchanged: query_with_too_much_join.
verification: Confirm that the review outcome records presence or absence of multi_table_join without adding SQL text, identifiers, object names, or inferred counts.
Confirm that any later human decision distinguishes direct query-shape evidence from merely contextual observations.
rollback: No database rollback is required because the action is inspection-only.
Discard or mark invalid any temporary review notes if they are found to rely on SQL text, identifiers, counts, or facts not present in the supplied evidence.

steps: Review the available query-shape artifacts specifically for an ordering clause, because mechanism-01 identifies ordering_clause as direct semantic evidence for the frozen order_by root.
Record only whether the captured artifacts show, do not show, or are insufficient to determine an ordering clause; do not infer SQL text, identifiers, or plan details absent from the evidence.
preconditions: Use only already captured or read-only query-shape artifacts from the execution-plan or instrumented-statement-history channels described in observation-02.
Keep the frozen root set unchanged: order_by only.
Do not execute mutating SQL, DDL, restarts, session termination, or configuration changes.
verification: A human reviewer can confirm the review output cites the captured artifact source channels from observation-02.
The review result states one bounded outcome: ordering clause present, absent, or not determinable from supplied artifacts.
rollback: No database rollback is required for a read-only review.
If the review notes are found to rely on facts not present in the captured artifacts, discard or amend those notes.

steps: Review the anonymous statement shape from the cited observations for filtered_relation_read and range_or_comparison_predicate, including the broad_filtered_scan noted in observation-02.
Compare the observed predicate/access shape against available read-only index metadata to assess whether it remains consistent with the missing_index mechanism in mechanism-02.
Record only a bounded result: consistent, not consistent from available artifacts, or inconclusive.
preconditions: Treat the selected root set as frozen; this is a read-only validation review, not a diagnosis change.
Use only read-only access to the captured execution-plan/instrumented-statement-history context and read-only index or catalog metadata, if available.
Do not apply DDL, hints, configuration changes, session termination, or workload-altering tests.
verification: Confirm the reviewed material corresponds to the cited source channels: execution_plan and instrumented_statement_history.
Confirm the review references only observed shapes: broad_filtered_scan, filtered_relation_read, and range_or_comparison_predicate.
Confirm no schema, data, configuration, session, or workload state was changed.
rollback: No database rollback is expected because the action is non-mutating.
Discard local notes or annotations if the reviewed artifacts cannot be matched to the cited observations.

steps: Review the current data-lock wait relationships behind the observed row_lock_wait signal.
Check whether current lock-wait evidence is still present alongside elevated recent lock-wait trajectories described in the observations.
Document only non-mutating findings needed for a later human decision, without inferring missing SQL text, identifiers, lock owners, or counts.
preconditions: Use only read-only inspection of existing lock-wait/lock-occupancy instrumentation.
Do not terminate sessions, modify transactions, change configuration, or issue DDL/DML.
Treat correlated lock-wait metrics as one evidence family and do not infer counts or ownership not present in the evidence.
verification: The review confirms whether current row-lock wait relationships are present or absent at inspection time.
Findings cite the supplied record_lock mechanism: elevated lock-wait or row_lock_wait evidence is direct evidence for record-lock contention.
No session state, transaction state, schema, data, or configuration was changed.
rollback: No database rollback is required for a read-only review.
Discard any temporary notes or snapshots if the review scope was incorrect or unauthorized.

steps: Review the anonymous runtime SQL-shape context from observation-02 for the reported predicate_type_conversion on a range_or_comparison_predicate.
Check whether that predicate conversion is associated with the reported filtered_relation_read or broad_filtered_scan context.
Document only whether the shape is consistent with mechanism-01: runtime predicate conversion can make a selective condition non-sargable and increase access work.
preconditions: Limit the review to non-mutating execution-plan and instrumented-statement-history metadata already represented by observation-02.
Keep the frozen root as implicit_conversion; do not infer lock ownership or contention from this action.
verification: Positive validation requires the reviewed metadata to show predicate_type_conversion in the predicate context described by observation-02.
If predicate_type_conversion cannot be confirmed in that context, mark the inspection inconclusive and defer any human remediation decision.
rollback: No database state is changed; rollback is simply to stop the review.
If the review is inconclusive, discard any draft remediation assumption based on implicit conversion impact.

steps: Review the captured anonymous SQL-shape metadata for observation-02 and note whether predicate_type_conversion and broad_filtered_scan/filtered_relation_read are confirmed in the same captured shape.

If included in the same read-only review, note whether observation-03 confirms broad_filtered_scan with filtered_relation_read/range_or_comparison_predicate; do not infer object names or index definitions.
Record findings only as present, absent, or not verifiable against the mechanisms: predicate_type_conversion for implicit_conversion and broad_filtered_scan as contextual evidence for missing_index.
preconditions: Frozen root set remains only implicit_conversion and missing_index.
Reviewer has read-only access to the already captured execution-plan and instrumented-statement-history metadata referenced by the observations.
No statement execution, schema/data/configuration change, session termination, or remediation DDL is performed.
verification: Review notes cite the observation and mechanism IDs used.
Notes state whether the supplied shape tokens were confirmed or not verifiable.
No database state, workload, lock/session state, configuration, or root-set change occurred.
rollback: No database rollback is required for read-only review.
If the review note is unsupported, discard or correct it and leave the frozen root set unchanged.

steps: Review the current lock-wait relationships indicated by the row_lock_wait observation and lock-wait metric trajectory.
Check whether the observed lock waits align with the record_lock mechanism: conflicting record activity producing elevated lock-wait evidence.
Document only the anonymous wait-chain facts available from approved instrumentation for later human decision-making.
preconditions: Use only read-only diagnostic access to current lock-wait instrumentation or already captured observations.
Do not terminate sessions, change transactions, modify schema, or change configuration.
Treat correlated lock-wait metrics as one evidence family, not separate independent proof.
verification: Confirm whether current data-lock wait relationships or row-lock waits are still present during the review window.
Confirm that no mutating action was performed.
Confirm that the review produced bounded evidence usable by a human to decide whether record-lock contention needs intervention.
rollback: No database state changes are expected from a read-only review.
Stop the review if it would require session termination, transaction changes, DDL, or configuration changes.

steps: Review the current lock-wait relationships associated with the observed row_lock_wait signal to determine whether a bounded lock chain is visible.
Correlate the lock-wait relationship with currently active execution/concurrency context only at the descriptive level provided by the instrumentation.
Document whether the observed wait relationship is still present, has cleared, or cannot be resolved from available evidence.
preconditions: Use only existing runtime/instrumentation evidence; do not terminate sessions, change transaction state, modify schema, or change configuration.
Treat correlated lock-wait metrics as one evidence family, per observation-01, and do not double-count them.
Keep the frozen root set unchanged: query_whole_table and record_lock.
verification: Confirm that the review used observation-03 row_lock_wait evidence and observation-01 lock-wait trajectory evidence as validation inputs.
Confirm that the interpretation remains aligned with mechanism-02, where lock-wait evidence is direct evidence for record_lock.
Confirm that no session termination, transaction intervention, schema change, or configuration change was performed.
rollback: No database rollback is required because the recommendation is inspection-only.
If the review cannot be completed from existing instrumentation, stop and escalate to a human operator rather than enabling new state-changing actions.

steps: Review the captured predicate and access-path metadata for the anonymous runtime shapes that include predicate_type_conversion, broad_filtered_scan, filtered_relation_read, and range_or_comparison_predicate.

For implicit_conversion, check whether the observed predicate_type_conversion is associated with a predicate or join condition in a way that could make the condition non-sargable, consistent with mechanism-01.

For missing_index, compare the observed broad_filtered_scan pattern against available read-only index metadata to determine whether a useful supporting index appears absent, consistent with mechanism-02.
preconditions: Use read-only access only to the already captured execution-plan and instrumented statement-history artifacts referenced by the observations.
Do not change SQL text, indexes, schema, data, sessions, configuration, or workload during this review.
Keep the frozen root set limited to implicit_conversion and missing_index.
verification: A later human decision is better supported only if the review confirms the same predicate_type_conversion and/or broad_filtered_scan patterns in the captured artifacts.
Record conclusions as validation notes only; do not prescribe or apply datatype, query, or index changes from this step.
If the artifacts do not confirm these patterns, abstain from recommending remediation based on this review.
rollback: No database rollback is required because the action is non-mutating.
Discard or supersede any review notes if the captured artifacts cannot be tied back to the observed query-shape evidence.

steps: Review the captured SQL-shape evidence in observation-02, focusing on the predicate_type_conversion annotation.
Check whether the observed predicate_type_conversion is associated with the observed range_or_comparison_predicate, filtered_relation_read, or broad_filtered_scan shape.
Document whether the observation is consistent with mechanism-01: a runtime predicate conversion can make selective access less sargable and increase access work.
preconditions: Use only the already captured execution-plan and instrumented-statement-history artifacts referenced by observation-02.
Keep the review read-only and non-mutating; do not execute changes or generate replacement SQL.
Limit scope to validating the frozen implicit_conversion diagnosis context.
verification: A human reviewer can trace the finding directly to observation-02 and mechanism-01.
The review produces a bounded yes/no/uncertain note on whether the captured shape supports later consideration of predicate/type alignment.
No schema, data, configuration, session, or workload state was changed.
rollback: No database rollback is required for a read-only review.
Discard or supersede any local notes if the reviewed artifact is later found to be stale or out of scope.

steps: Review the current captured plan/history shape for the anonymous statements that show aggregation_clause and unrestricted_relation_read from observation-02.
Review the current captured plan/history shape for broad_filtered_scan, filtered_relation_read, and range_or_comparison_predicate from observation-03.

Document whether the observed shape is sufficient for a later human decision about aggregation work under mechanism-01 and broad access path with predicate/index review under mechanism-02, without inferring identifiers or proposing changes.
preconditions: Keep the frozen root set unchanged: group_by and missing_index only.
Use only existing execution-plan and instrumented-statement-history artifacts referenced by the observations.
Perform a read-only inspection; do not change SQL, schema, indexes, configuration, sessions, or data.
verification: Confirm the inspection output cites only observed clauses/operators and the supplied evidence IDs.
Confirm no mutating action was performed.
